title: FOIA Routing and Appeal Clock Navigator
tagline: The right to ask survives only if the request reaches the right component in time.

cards: A federal request looks like one universal inbox.
Routing, existing releases, tracking, and appeals form a state machine.
A helpful answer can invent custody or an exemption result.
The officer owns the search while every requester right remains visible.

story.headline: The transparent request sent to the wrong office
beats: A requester describes records held somewhere inside a large agency.
A proactive release exists, but a remaining record belongs to another component.
Generic submission loses routing time and may invent what the search will find.
The navigator preserves component, tracking, fees, and appeal recourse.
